title: Skill-dispatch §13.7 benchset / bench-result (SCAFFOLD — no real measurements shipped yet)
description: The MEASURED side of §13.7, consumed + produced by scripts/skills-bench.js. The task-set (task-set.schema.json) is the INPUT (tasks + thresholds); this carries the per-task A/B token MEASUREMENTS (the orchestrator-side inline vs envelope token counts) plus the two-axis verdict the harness computes. A skill earns `execution: subprocess` (subprocess_verified:true) ONLY when BOTH axes pass; otherwise it stays inline (PLAN §13.7 + §17.5). For the FIXTURE path the measurements are SYNTHETIC and the judge is STUBBED (no real replay, no spend).

skill.description: The skill under measurement. Must be a `subprocess` candidate in the registry under test, and §13.6-runnable, before §13.7 finalization is meaningful.

subprocess_verified_prereq.description: Asserts §13.6 was passed (skills-test --mode ping proved it RUNS headless) before this benchset was authored. §13.7 depends on §13.6.

thresholds.description: The fail-closed bars BOTH axes must clear (mirrors task-set.schema.json#thresholds).

min_tokens_saved.description: Axis 1: minimum MEAN net orchestrator tokens saved per task. Light skills (envelope ≈ inline) fall below and STAY INLINE.

min_pct_saved.description: Axis 1: minimum fraction of total inline orchestrator cost saved.

quality_tolerance.description: Axis 2: how far BELOW inline quality the subprocess result may fall and still pass (0 = must be >= inline).

dispatch_overhead.description: Optional override of the subprocess-arm orchestrator overhead model. Defaults (skills-bench.js#DEFAULT_DISPATCH_OVERHEAD) are grounded in oneshot-token-guide.md's orchestrator-tokens-per-activity table, conservative (high) end. Envelope-read tokens are NOT here — they are the per-task measured envelope_tokens.

background_notification.description: Background-task notification cost (~300–800; default 800, conservative high).

judge.description: Axis 2 quality grader metadata — independent + CROSS-PROVIDER (no self-grading). For the FIXTURE path the judge is STUBBED via SKILLS_BENCH_JUDGE_OVERRIDE; a future real run dispatches a different-provider reviewer on anonymized arms (the diff-model-review pattern, GPT Pro §9.4). The judge is for the SUBJECTIVE delta / high-risk routing / calibration — NOT the sole oracle (§17.5).

provider.description: A provider DIFFERENT from the skill's executor.

anonymized.description: Arms presented WITHOUT inline/subprocess labels (blind A/B).

verdict.description: The independent judge's ruling. The harness READS this; it never self-grades.

score.description: Optional signed quality delta (subprocess − inline, normalized). Pass when score >= -quality_tolerance.

context_needed.description: Optional: if the subprocess arm only matched inline once specific context was fed into the dispatch prompt, record WHAT context it needs (stamped into the registry so the dispatcher supplies it).

measurements.description: Per-task A/B MEASUREMENTS. A single run is insufficient (§17.5) — several tasks average out retries/summarization/review churn. inline_orchestrator_tokens = tokens the full skill output costs Alpha's context inline; envelope_tokens = tokens the ≤8-line subprocess envelope costs Alpha. net per task = inline − (envelope + dispatch_overhead).

task_id.description: Stable id, matches the task-set task_id.

inline_orchestrator_tokens.description: Orchestrator-side tokens the INLINE arm cost (full output into Alpha's context).

envelope_tokens.description: Orchestrator-side tokens the SUBPROCESS arm's ≤8-line envelope cost.

inline_artifact_digest.description: Optional digest of the inline run's artifact (proof the arm actually produced output — §17.4).

subprocess_artifact_digest.description: Optional digest of the subprocess run's artifact.
